workflow.what: The talking ad line, with the three roles at their stations. The one person stop is the quote, before any money moves; every review is decided by the decision layer and filed for the owner to overrule. Going live stays his click on the approval page.
workflow.ruled: Owner, 2026-11-02: build the system for talking ads through the three roles.

steps.name: Ad Plan
steps.does: The strategist writes one Ad Plan page from the swipe or idea, in the workflow folder as ad-plan.md Also write runs/video-production/{brand}/workflow-{label}/ad-plan-review.json as {"files": {"repo-relative-output-path": "sha256"}}, covering exactly the listed output files. The decision layer reviews it; nothing waits for the owner.

steps.name: Ad Plan review
steps.does: The decision layer (video-teardown decide.py) passes this exact version from the owner's past calls and files the call in runs/decisions/calls.jsonl for him to agree with or overrule later; the run continues and nothing waits for him. An overruled version goes back to its authoring station.

steps.name: Accepted writing brief
steps.does: The writing chain runs with the decision layer on: python3 components/video-writing/machine/run.py {teardown} --autonomous (the teardown or scratch run's label). Every structure, hook, audit, swipe-match and manifest hold is decided from the owner's past calls and filed for him to overrule; the run continues. A run that still stops is diagnosed and fixed in the session, never sent to the owner. Retain the actual writing run and maker brief; a held or stale brief is not complete and goes back to writing, never around it. Writing costs are never quoted.

steps.name: Brief review
steps.does: The decision layer (video-teardown decide.py) passes this exact version from the owner's past calls and files the call in runs/decisions/calls.jsonl for him to agree with or overrule later; the run continues and nothing waits for him. An overruled version goes back to its authoring station.

steps.name: Shot plan
steps.does: The director writes the shot plan, look, locks and takes into shot-plan.md in the workflow folder, following the talking recipe, before any money moves

steps.name: The quote, then the owner's go
steps.stops_for: the owner: the quote (his only stop)
steps.does: THE ONE STOP. Before any money moves, price every paid step from here to the cut on the house models (components/generative-model-house/MODEL-HOUSE.md): voice, every start picture and B-roll picture, the two proof clips and every remaining clip with its retake allowance, each as count x unit price, with the total and the stop point. Write runs/video-production/{brand}/workflow-{label}/quote.json as {"total_usd": <number>, "lines": [{"what", "count", "unit_usd", "usd"}], "stop_point": "..."} and show the owner the total and what it buys. Only his own go in chat opens the spend: record it with workflow.py go <format> --brand {brand} --label {label} --approved-by <name> --said "<his words>" --cap <dollars>, then complete this station. Writing costs are never quoted (owner, 2026-11-25). Never record a go he did not give. Spend past the cap is a new quote, never a quiet overrun.

steps.name: Voice and storyboard
steps.does: Use the approved brief and authored shot plan. Inside the owner's go (go.json and its cap), run run_v2.py start {brief} --brand {brand} --label {production_label} --voice-only --go runs/video-production/{brand}/workflow-{label}/go.json, then run_v2.py storyboard runs/video-production/{brand}/{production_label} --brief {brief} --go runs/video-production/{brand}/workflow-{label}/go.json. Both commands are under components/video-production/machine/. Reuse verified outputs. Stop before pictures: start without flags and start --storyboard create pictures and do not belong here. Never bypass writing acceptance or picture approvals.

steps.name: Element breakdown
steps.does: Every swipe scene read to its elements, and each element marked keep or swap for ours

steps.name: 3D shot set
steps.does: One 3D set per place and camera, with the stand-in and light locked, printed and linked to every shot

steps.name: Start picture
steps.does: One start picture, signed off by the system's reviewer under the go (run_v2.py --go; a flagged picture is held and remade, never shipped), for the talking takes, then only the B-roll and demos the script needs, all from the shot set through image production on the board Also write runs/video-production/{brand}/workflow-{label}/pictures-review.json as {"files": {"repo-relative-output-path": "sha256"}}, covering exactly the listed output files. The decision layer reviews it; nothing waits for the owner.

steps.name: All clips
steps.does: The remaining clips through the board, three takes at most per shot; each failure gets one named reason and one change. The producer records the go-ahead total in clips-done.md in the workflow folder

steps.name: First-take score
steps.does: Counts shots right on take one and why the rest failed; the board shows this file

steps.name: Teach the recipe
